summary: Authors magic-square puzzles — interactive n×n grids where students fill in missing numbers so every row, column, and diagonal sums to the same magic number.
in_scope: Magic-square puzzles of arbitrary size with equal row/column/diagonal sum constraints
Pre-filled cells (initializeGrid) to scaffold the puzzle
Problem statement, magic-number/sum expression, and feedback display
out_of_scope: Any puzzle that isn't a magic-square sum puzzle (sudoku, kenken, crosswords, logic grids, word searches, slide puzzles)
Non-sum puzzles (sudoku, kenken, crosswords, logic grids)
Full assessment items (multi-part questions, rubrics) — use L0158
Generic spreadsheets or free-form table data — use L0166
Dynamic puzzle generation at runtime — L0154 configures a specific puzzle
